primary_definition: edge iff centre-distance < 50 km (2 x 25) and |dt| < 30 d

robustness.reading: episodes range across definitional choices; the M6 is captured in every variant, and episode precision stays low (one true episode among many) throughout -- the conclusion does not rest on any single definition.

hit_episode_detail.note: the one hit episode is the Kumburgaz mainshock-day sequence: 62 triggers collapse to 1 episode. This is exactly what deduplication should do -- without it those 62 inflate both numerator and denominator.

boundary_note: union region-time samples only inside the model box; edge triggers whose cylinders extend outside are partially counted (minor, conservative for the footprint).
molchan_n1_caveat: Molchan point (tau=0.033, nu=0) rests on n=1 M6; it is illustrative, not a statistical skill estimate.
CONCLUSION: Deduplication into episodes does NOT rescue the foreshock signal: 673 triggers -> ~337 episodes (313-405 across all definitional choices), the M6 is one episode among them (precision <=0.32%%, false-alarm ratio >=99.68%%) in every variant, and the union footprint is 3.3%% of model-box space-time. Same conclusion as the raw trigger count, now robust to the clustering objection.
